back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Guardian cards ([guardian]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, [[Tactic]] cards level 0. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): The Home Front, Shell Shock, Sophie, 1 random basic weakness.
